channel.title: Cli | AI Engineering
channel.description: A 23-chapter handbook for Claude Code — permissions, context, skills, hooks, MCP and agents, worked out end to end for engineers who have to ship with it.

item.title: Three Ways to Talk to Claude Code
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: CLI flags, slash commands and in-prompt sigils are three separate input channels, distinguished by when they are parsed and whether they reach the model at all. The mental model, the handful you actually use, and where the full reference lives.
